definition.comment: Incurred expenses, no payment status. SQL recalculates allocations from historical contributions; referral transaction identity is immutable. No historical backfill.

Ref Offset Payment.name: Ref Offset Payment

pwa_versioned_envelope.name: pwa_versioned_envelope
pwa_versioned_envelope.definition:
CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(canonical_json::jsonb) = 'object'::text AND (canonical_json::jsonb ->> 'contractVersion'::text) = contract_version::text AND
CASE
    WHEN contract_version = 1 THEN canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{command,requestId}'::text[]
    ELSE canonical_json::jsonb ->> 'requestId'::text
END = request_id::text AND (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{actor,issuer}'::text[]) = actor_issuer AND (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{actor,subject}'::text[]) = actor_subject AND (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{actor,partnerId}'::text[]) = actor_partner_id AND (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{actor,loginEmail}'::text[]) = actor_login_email) IS TRUE)

pwa_versioned_outcome.name: pwa_versioned_outcome
pwa_versioned_outcome.definition: CHECK ((contract_version = 1 AND result_json IS NULL AND (outcome = 'posted'::text AND payment_id = ('pwa:'::text || request_id::text) AND rejection_code IS NULL OR outcome = 'rejected'::text AND payment_id IS NULL AND (rejection_code = ANY (ARRAY['invalid_date'::text, 'borrower_unavailable'::text, 'account_unavailable'::text, 'selection_unavailable'::text]))) OR contract_version = 2 AND payment_id IS NULL AND (outcome = 'applied'::text AND rejection_code IS NULL AND jsonb_typeof(result_json) = 'object'::text AND octet_length(result_json::text) <= 524288 AND result_json ?& ARRAY['operation'::text, 'targetType'::text, 'targetId'::text, 'paymentId'::text, 'plan'::text, 'predecessorRequestId'::text] AND (result_json - ARRAY['operation'::text, 'targetType'::text, 'targetId'::text, 'paymentId'::text, 'plan'::text, 'predecessorRequestId'::text, 'sourceCreatedBy'::text, 'rebate'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb AND (NOT result_json ? 'rebate'::text OR (result_json ->> 'operation'::text) = 'loan.close'::text AND jsonb_typeof(result_json -> 'rebate'::text) = 'object'::text) AND (NOT result_json ? 'sourceCreatedBy'::text OR (jsonb_typeof(result_json -> 'sourceCreatedBy'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['string'::text, 'null'::text]))) AND (result_json ->> 'operation'::text) = (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{command,operation}'::text[]) AND (result_json ->> 'targetType'::text) = (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{command,targetType}'::text[]) AND (result_json ->> 'targetId'::text) = (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{command,targetId}'::text[]) OR outcome = 'rejected'::text AND result_json IS NULL AND (rejection_code = ANY (ARRAY['source_conflict'::text, 'not_found'::text, 'invalid_reference'::text, 'borrower_name_exists'::text, 'dependency_conflict'::text, 'insufficient_funds'::text, 'plan_changed'::text, 'invalid_date'::text, 'account_unavailable'::text, 'record_requires_reconciliation'::text])))) IS TRUE)
